description: Rapid password brute force against d.miller (5 failures in 2 min)
rationale: Matches DET-AUTH-001 threshold of 5 failures in 5 minutes from same IP and user.

description: Horizontal password spraying across 8 distinct accounts from 203.0.113.200
rationale: Matches DET-AUTH-002 threshold of 8 distinct targeted users from 1 source IP in 10 minutes.

description: Brute force followed by successful login and immediate DomainAdmin role escalation
rationale: Full compromise sequence triggering brute-force, post-failure success, and privilege escalation.

description: MFA prompt bombing / push exhaustion against c.taylor (2 denials in 1 min)
rationale: Matches DET-AUTH-004 threshold of 2 MFA denials within 10 minutes.

description: Distributed botnet credential stuffing against vip_exec from 4 distinct IPs
rationale: Matches DET-NET-001 threshold of 4 distinct source IPs targeting 1 user within 15 minutes.

description: Benign normal user password typo followed by success
rationale: 1 failure is not an attack; negative control demonstrating non-alerting behavior.

description: Slow sporadic failed logins (2 failures spread over 35 minutes)
rationale: Fails to meet failure rate threshold or time window.

description: Shared corporate proxy with occasional normal logins/failures from 3 users
rationale: Only 3 users (spray threshold requires 8); negative control for shared egress points.

description: Authorized administrative role change with approved change ticket CHG-8812
rationale: Privilege change is explicitly approved and not preceded by suspicious authentication.

description: Boundary negative control: 4 failures in 2 minutes (threshold is 5)
rationale: Strict boundary condition test; 4 failures should never trigger a threshold of 5.
